This is an open-ended creative generation task. Plover scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and, more importantly, Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work — it prefers tasks with clearer completion criteria. The brainstorming request benefits from a model without that creative aversion.

Plover scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and substantially higher on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3), making it better suited for producing constrained creative output that follows precise instructions.
